provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized bicycle at m=331, a prime with ord_2(m)=30, so the nontrivial cyclotomic cosets of 2 all have size 30. The divisor g is one such coset's minimal polynomial, of degree 61, which fixes k = 2 deg g = 122 by construction. The pair (a,b) was then drawn from the ideal (g) by information-set decoding over sparse supports, keeping weights 12 and 14; both are odd, so x+1 does not divide the gcd and no weight-m block logical is forced. H_X = [circ(a) | circ(b)] and H_Z = [circ(b)^T | circ(a)^T] on n = 2m = 662 qubits at uniform row weight 26, with a = [30, 32, 50, 57, 58, 85, 181, 195, 260, 268, 325, 326] and b = [33, 36, 41, 45, 49, 95, 101, 213, 224, 228, 256, 284, 306, 321].
provenance.notes: Distance is an upper bound from the lighter of two witnesses, weight 84 on X and 84 on Z, both carried in this file. A 24-seed randomized information-set search at 2,000,000 trials per seed spread 84 to 88 with the minimum found by one seed. A single run of 8,000,000 trials, matching the verifier's own depth, reads 85. A search restricted to logicals supported inside one circulant block, which a general search is blind to, found one of weight 91, above this claim. Folding onto the x^t-invariant subspaces leaves a lightest surviving logical of weight 182. The design point is deg g / m = 0.184.
